research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Wright Electric is researching lightweight high temperature battery systems using polymer casings that withstand heat from chemically active materials, portable generators integrating electric machines, power converters and housings, waste heat control for aircraft fuel cells with diverter based transfer systems, and aircraft propulsion liquid cooling where electric motors, power electronic modules and AC leads are thermally and electrically integrated; together these efforts target batteries, portable power, heat management and electric propulsion.

overview_description.description: Wright Electric's unique propulsion technology and forthcoming airplanes eliminate emissions without the need for offsets, lowering the cost of zero-emissions flight to the same level as running a fossil-fueled fleet and ushering in the next age of aviation through the electrification of the aerospace sector.

about_short_description.short_description: Wright Electric is a leader in the future of sustainable, lower emissions air travel.

product.name: Wright Spirit Aircraft
product.description: A 100-passenger hybrid-electric aircraft designed for one-hour regional flights, using a megawatt-class propulsion system to reduce emissions.

product.name: WM2500 Electric Aircraft Motor
product.description: A 2.5 MW electric motor delivering high power-to-weight ratio for aviation propulsion, enabling zero-emission flights with efficient thrust.

product.name: Wright Dynamo Tactical Generator
product.description: A portable 30 kW generator and aircraft start cart that also functions as a microgrid hub, supporting AC and DC power inputs and outputs for defense and aerospace use.

product.name: Ultra-Lightweight Battery Systems
product.description: Next-generation batteries developed to be up to four times lighter than lithium-ion, designed for electric aircraft, marine vessels, and heavy-duty transportation.

product.name: Off-Grid Power Systems
product.description: Modular power systems combining batteries, inverters, and generators to provide microgrid capabilities for remote or off-grid military, humanitarian, and telecom applications.
